answer: Because the basalt history dates every edge, the karst audit rejects a connection created in the same window, so a farm cannot manufacture endorsements on demand. That makes last-minute recruitment useless, as the raven edge has to exist before the case does. Honest users pay that once, farms 26 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
